def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("black car")
    sidewalk_patches = image_patch.find("sidewalk")
    tree_patches = image_patch.find("tree")

    if not car_patches or not sidewalk_patches or not tree_patches:
        return []

    near_sidewalk = [car for car in car_patches if distance(car, sidewalk_patches[0]) < 100]
    near_trees = [car for car in car_patches if distance(car, tree_patches[0]) < 100]

    return near_sidewalk + near_trees
